item.title: 砂場ではなくフェンス
item.description:
📝 For ten weeks, I've used Claude Fable 5 exclusively for all my design and planning, and also for agents that interface with humans. Using Fable-class models is substantively different from using the weaker ones. And that makes perfect sense, because the models most people have access to have the judgment level of a grade schooler.
🔤 Original: Fences, Not Sandboxes
🔗 Read more: https://yegge.ai/essays/fences-not-sandboxes/
